response.original_title: Oslo – The Wild Heart of Norway
response.overview: The Wild Heart of Norway is a cinematic documentary set entirely in Oslo, Norway’s capital. Yet it is not a film about people. It’s about the animals — wolves, foxes, badgers, moose, peregrine falcons, salmon, mink, and beavers — that thrive in the seams of city life.
response.tagline: A film about the wild lives woven through Norway’s capital, where city and wilderness collide
response.title: Oslo – The Wild Heart of Norway
